title: Senior Product Manager, Inventory
description:
Change the way the world travels 
 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
 Role Overview 
 As a Senior Product Manager, you will be an integral part of a cross-functional team, working closely with other product managers, engineers, UX designers, researchers, and data professionals. Your role involves creating and executing a vision for a product area, constantly learning from our customers, and iterating to improve the user experience. You will also collaborate with our UX team, composed of product designers, researchers, and writers.
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can envision GetYourGuide beyond its current state, champion our users' voices, and execute a compelling vision. 
 Successful PMs at GetYourGuide bring a growth mindset and drive business and customer impact by identifying opportunities, getting buy-in from your stakeholders, and executing with urgency.
 Team Mission 
 The Inventory teams own the systems, processes, and logic behind how suppliers manage their availability and prices with GetYourGuide, along with a set of supplier-facing solutions. Our goal is to run this efficiently and reliably for a wide range of suppliers and destinations.
 As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy for a product area in one of our three Inventory teams. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, a product designer, and an analyst, you will shape the systems, flows, and logic behind availability and pricing, as well as the solutions suppliers use every day.
 This is a cross-functional space. You will work closely with Care, Finance, Business Operations, Sales, and other teams across GetYourGuide, and with suppliers directly.
 We are looking for a product manager who thinks in systems, brings strategic clarity and executional rigor, and enjoys untangling complex problems.
 What You'll Do 
 Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month strategy for your product area, set clear, measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.
 Supplier empathy: Build a deep understanding of suppliers: their business, their needs, and the problems they face. Turn those insights into hypotheses, and represent supplier needs at every level of the organization.
 Prioritization: Analyze supplier and traveler feedback, market trends, and business metrics to choose the few problems that matter most. Be explicit about what we will not build, and make clear decisions on sequencing to maximize impact and learning.
 Systems thinking: Shape the systems, processes, and logic behind availability and pricing so they scale and run efficiently for suppliers and GetYourGuide.
 Collaboration: Co-create solutions with your team and with partners across the company. Work together to unlock new opportunities for suppliers and for GetYourGuide.
 Communication: Connect your roadmap to the company’s mission and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision, with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.
 Experimentation: Plan and execute experiments to test hypotheses. Use the results to evaluate your team’s investment and inform future product decisions.
 Leadership: Act with openness and transparency with your team and peers, and coach others on product craft.
 Your toolkit 
 5+ years of professional experience in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a product area: strategy, KPI setup, goal-setting, and roadmap execution.
 Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams and stakeholders in a collaborative way that is aligned with our Guiding Principles.
 Curiosity about suppliers’ businesses and how destinations work.
 Regular, effective use of AI tools in your work.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Great if you have, but not mandatory: Strong data analytics skills with the ability to derive insights from large data sets.
 Bonus: Experience with inventory, marketplace, platform, or travel products.
 Bonus: An engineering or analytics background, or hands-on experience with systems and integrations.
 How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary 
 Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
 Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
 A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. 
 Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
 Monthly transportation and fitness budget
 Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
 Language reimbursement program
 Health and wellness benefits
 And more…
 How to apply 
 Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘ how we hire ’ and ‘ life at GetYourGuide ’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com .
 We’re an equal opportunities employer 
 Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

title: Chief of Staff & Lead Special Operations, Global Procurement (m/w/d)
Staff Product Manager (on-site)
description:
Your role
 Cloover's platform now runs how thousands of installers get onboarded, verified, invoiced, and financed. As we scale, the hardest product problems no longer sit inside one squad. You'll own that area, set the direction several squads build toward, and stay close enough to the work to make the hard calls yourself. 
 Reporting to our Head of Product and partnering closely with Staff and Senior Engineers, designers, and operations leads, and act as the senior product voice for your area. 
Your mission
 Set the multi-quarter product strategy for that drive Cloovers growth with our Installers and customers through product innovation.   
 Lead product direction across multiple squads, aligning engineering, design, operations, and commercial teams on shared priorities so the platform moves as one system rather than separate features. 
 Partner with Staff Engineers, bringing the product perspective and championing our customers in the future direction of our platform.   
 Turn the most ambiguous, high-stakes problems in the business into clear product bets: run discovery with installers and internal teams, dig into usage data, and validate before committing engineering time. 
 Stay close to the work: write the specs for the hardest problems yourself, make daily trade-off calls with your squads, and ship features that reach real customers and move real metrics. 
 Raise the product bar across the team by setting standards for discovery, requirements, and outcome measurement, and by mentoring other PMs. 
 Use AI as a default part of how you work and what we build: prototype, research, and analyse with it, and identify where it can automate operational workflows 
Your profile
 We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role: 
 Roughly 8+ years in product, including meaningful time at Senior level owning product end to end, with shipped outcomes you can quantify. 
 You thrive off ownership! You have experience owning scope outside of your remit and are comfortable making decisions that will supercharge our amazing growth.  
 You have set and driven product strategy spanning multiple teams or a platform, and can walk us through a bet you made, how you got people aligned behind it, and what happened. 
 Have built multi-sided or platform products, ideally where internal operations tooling and customer-facing product depend on each other. 
 Ability to go deep with engineers on APIs, data models, and system trade-offs, and experience changing technical direction when the product needed it. 
 Make high-stakes decisions with incomplete information and can explain the reasoning clearly to founders, engineers, and operations alike. 
 Run discovery hands-on: user interviews, data analysis, usability testing, and prototyping to validate direction before building. 
 Delivered in environments where urgency is the norm, and knows when to ship and when to push back on scope or quality. 
 Based in Berlin and energized by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first: decisions get made in real time, prototypes get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten meters away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here. 
 Nice to have (but not required) 
 Experience with fintech, lending, payments, or KYC and compliance products. 
 German language proficiency (B2 or above). 
 Don't meet every requirement?  Apply anyway. We hire for potential and perspective. Credentials are a starting point, not a ceiling. 
How we hire
 We keep things transparent and respect your time. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks. 
 Intro call  (30 min): We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV. 
 Hiring manager interview  (30 min): We go deep into your experience, your thinking, and how you approach problems. 
 Product Deep Dive Interview:   (1 hour): A chance for you to show your depth of knowledge and experience. 
 Founder Interview  (30 min): Final stage to meet one of our founders and get a picture of where Cloover is going.  
 Offer & signed contract. 
 Need any adjustments at any stage? Just let us know. 
Why us?
 Performance pay.  Strong base and a bonus tied to outcomes, recognised when it happens rather than locked behind annual cycles. 
 AI-first & unthrottled.  Unlimited enterprise-grade AI, no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement. 
 Real ownership on a real mission.  From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software. We're powering the energy transition across Europe. 
 Grow faster than anywhere else.  You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in. 
Perks & Benefits
 Latest Apple hardware  in our Prenzlauer Berg office 
 25 days vacation 
 €500 per year  learning & development budget 
 WHOOP Peak, covered.  After six months with us, we cover your WHOOP Peak membership in full 
 Urban Sports Club (M)  membership 
 Deutschlandticket , fully covered 
 Cloover Power Tariff:  our own green power tariff, with the monthly base fee on us 
 Free catered lunch  every day in the office (via Bella&Bona) 
 Free dinner  every day in the office (via Wolt) 
 Fully stocked kitchen  with breakfast, snacks, and drinks 
 Team events  with €50 per person per month 
 Company discounts  via Corporate Benefits and FutureBens

title: Product Owner (m/w/d) – Secure Communication & File Sharing
description:

**Wer wir sind**
----------------
**Zertificon Solutions – Software-Hersteller seit 2004. –** Wir sind IT-Security-Spezialisten: Unsere Produkte verschlüsseln die Kommunikation von Unternehmen. Mehr als 25 % der 100 umsatzstärksten deutschen Unternehmen sowie Hunderte Mittelständler aller Branchen nutzen bereits unsere Z1 Verschlüsselungslösungen. Wir haben noch viel mehr vor und wachsen stetig. Fast 140 Mitarbeiter arbeiten bereits bei uns in Neukölln. Komm in unser professionelles, hochqualifiziertes Team: Nimm die Herausforderungen an, teile Dein Wissen, lerne dazu und entdecke Dein Potenzial!
**Deine Aufgaben**
------------------
Als Product Owner gestaltest Du die Weiterentwicklung zweier Legacy-Produkte zu einer innovativen B2B-Lösung für sicheren Dateiaustausch und passwortbasierte E-Mail-Kommunikation. Die Lösung umfasst sowohl eine Administrationsoberfläche für unsere Geschäftskunden als auch eine Benutzeroberfläche für deren Kommunikationspartner. 
Unser Ziel ist es, nicht nur unsere Bestandskunden zu begeistern, sondern auch neue Märkte zu erschließen. Technologisch setzen wir auf Container und Microservices und entwickeln eine Lösung, die sowohl als SaaS-Angebot als auch On-Premises betrieben werden kann.
* Du entwickelst eigenständig Lösungskonzepte für neue und bestehende Funktionen und berücksichtigst dabei Kundenbedürfnisse, technische Möglichkeiten und Unternehmensziele
* Gemeinsam mit unserem UI/UX-Designer gestaltest Du nutzerfreundliche Lösungen und erstellst bei Bedarf kleinere Mockups selbst
* Für Dein Entwicklungsteam übersetzt Du abgestimmte Lösungskonzepte in konkrete Epics, Tasks und User Stories mit klaren Akzeptanzkriterien
* Das Product Backlog Deines Entwicklungsteams liegt in Deiner Verantwortung – Du priorisierst Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben gut vorbereitet und verständlich sind
* Du planst und koordinierst Software-Releases und behältst dabei Termine, Abhängigkeiten und Risiken im Blick
* Als zentrale Ansprechperson für Dein Entwicklungsteam klärst Du fachliche Fragen und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Support und weiteren Stakeholdern
* Du analysierst Markttrends und das Wettbewerbsumfeld und nutzt die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse, um Verbesserungspotenziale für unsere Produkte zu identifizieren
**Dein Profil**
---------------
* Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung als Product Owner, Produktmanager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle in einem B2B-Softwareunternehmen mit agiler Softwareentwicklung
* Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Konzeption von Softwarefunktionen, der Formulierung klarer Anforderungen für Entwicklungsteams und der Pflege eines Product Backlogs
* Gutes technisches Verständnis von Softwarearchitekturen, Schnittstellen und modernen Webanwendungen
* Gute Kenntnisse von UI/UX-Prinzipien sowie Erfahrung mit Figma, Adobe XD oder vergleichbaren Tools
* Analytisches Denkvermögen, eine strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
* Starkes Interesse an Technologie, IT-Security und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen
* Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
**Wir bieten**
--------------
* **Flexible Arbeitszeiten** und **Home-Office Möglichkeit**
* **Mobilität:** Kostenloses Deutschlandticket, Job-Rad-Leasing oder Parking
* **Zuschüsse** für Essen (z.B. Lieferando) und Internet im Home-Office
* **Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft** für flexible Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnessangebote
* **Vorteile im Büro:** Dachterrassen & grüner Innenhof, Bio-Obst und -Getränke, Annahme privater Pakete
* **Get together:** monatlicher Pizzafriday im Office, regelmäßige Teamevents, große Sommerparty
* **Verantwortungsvolle Führung:** strukturiertes Onboarding, regelmäßiges Feedback, transparente Ziele
* **Innovativ ohne Startup-Risiko:** Seit zwei Jahrzehnten profitabel, investieren wir aus eigener Kraft in Innovation mit großem Marktpotenzial weltweit.
* **Internationales Team:** Über 120 Menschen aus mehr als 30 Nationen gestalten gemeinsam eine offene Arbeitsatmosphäre.
**Über uns**
------------
**Warum Zertificon?** 
Zertificon steht für *securing digital business*. Wir entwickeln IT-Sicherheitslösungen "Made in Germany", denen Unternehmen vertrauen – und die sie gern nutzen. 
* **Unabhängig & überzeugt:** Seit über 20 Jahren entwickeln wir sichere Kommunikationslösungen – eigentümergeführt, nachhaltig wachsend und mit Haltung
* **Sicherheit mit Sinn:** Wir glauben an die Freiheit digitaler Kommunikation. Wenn du findest, dass Edward Snowden als Whistleblower das Richtige getan hat, teilen wir vielleicht dieselben Werte. Als Zeichen unserer Überzeugung spenden wir nach bestandener Probezeit 1.000 € an eine Organisation, die Edward Snowden unterstützt – sofern du ihn in deiner Bewerbung erwähnt hast
* **Exzellenz durch Praxis:** Wir nehmen komplexe Herausforderungen an – weil wir es können. Unsere internen Expert:innen gehören zu den Besten – selbst externe Spezialisten lernen oft bei uns dazu. Wenn wir das beste Ergebnis wollen, machen wir es selbst
* **Agil aus Überzeugung:** Wir denken schnell, handeln pragmatisch und verbessern uns kontinuierlich. Keine aufgeblähten Prozesse, kein „weil wir es immer schon so gemacht haben“. Initiative ist willkommen – natürlich wird auch diese hinterfragt und nicht jede fixe Idee kommt durch
* **Sicherheit, die genutzt wird:** Wir bauen Software, die nicht nur sicher ist, sondern auch nutzbar – nicht nur für Großunternehmen mit Teams von IT-Sicherheitsspezialisten, sondern auch für kleine und mittlere Betriebe, die starke Sicherheit ohne Komplexität brauchen

title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware & Edge AI (d/f/m)
description:
About Us 
 Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.
 As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field.
 You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.
 What you'll do 
 Discovery and requirements 
 Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
 Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
 Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
 Roadmap and delivery 
 Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
 Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
 Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
 Systems and interoperability 
 Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
 Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
 Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
 Collaboration 
 Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.
 Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design.
 Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments.
 Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs.
 You should apply if you have 
 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI.
 Experience taking a connected hardware product from EVT/DVT through production into operational use, including in-field updates.
 Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works.
 Ability making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgment to know when a decision is risky enough to slow down.
 Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike.
 Motivation to contribute to European security and sovereignty.
 Willingness to travel regularly to military exercises, test ranges and customer sites in Germany and NATO partner countries, sometimes in demanding field conditions.
 Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2).
 Fluency in German and English (C1 or higher).
 You'd be a particularly great fit with 
 A degree in electrical, mechanical or systems engineering, robotics or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience bringing hardware products from prototype to production.
 Experience in military, public safety or other mission-critical operational environments.
 Exposure to sensor fusion, mesh networking or degraded RF environments, including familiarity with interoperability standards such as Cursor on Target, SAPIENT, ONVIF or ASTERIX.
 We Offer 
 Direct feedback from the field: you'll see the products you build tested in real operating environments by the people who use them.
 Prime Berlin-Mitte location – right between Alexanderplatz and Hackescher Markt.
 High degree of autonomy and ownership, and flat structure.
 Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
 Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
 30 days of paid time off.
 Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

Deine Neue Umgebung
 Hinter PharmaHera steht die Atida-Gruppe – eine der führenden europäischen Online-Apothekengruppen mit über 5 Millionen Kund*innen in 9 Ländern. In Kernmärkten wie Spanien, Portugal, Frankreich und Italien ist Atida mit bekannten Marken wie Mifarma, Dosfarma, Santédiscount oder eFarma bereits Marktführer.
Wir in Berlin sind das Kompetenzzentrum der Gruppe für Deutschland und die Niederlande: Als spezialisierter Dienstleister steuern wir E-Commerce, Marketing, IT und Logistik für unsere lokalen Partner-Apotheken wie APONEO. Bei uns verbindest du das internationale Know-how eines wachsenden europäischen Netzwerks mit agiler Teamarbeit und viel Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort.
Deine Mission
Als Loyalty Program Manager (m/w/d) in Berlin bist du die treibende Kraft für die strategische Weiterentwicklung unseres Cross-Brand-Payback-Programms Apo Cash. Deine Hauptaufgabe im E-Commerce Marketing ist es, Customer Engagement & Retention sowie den Customer Lifetime Value nachhaltig zu steigern und Kund*innen begeisternd an unsere Online-Plattformen zu binden.
 Strategie & Programmentwicklung: Du analysierst und optimierst fortlaufend das Apo Cash Programm, um das Engagement und die Bindung unserer Kund*innen zu maximieren.
 Analytics & Data Insights: Du wertest das Kundenverhalten sowie die zentralen Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs) des Treueprogramms systematisch aus und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
 Kampagnen & Kommunikation: Du konzipierst ansprechende Werbekampagnen und gezielte Kommunikationsmaßnahmen, um die Teilnahmequote sowie die Aktivität im Payback-Programm stetig zu steigern.
 Schnittstellen-Drehscheibe: Du arbeitest eng und proaktiv mit den Teams aus Retail Media, Marketing und Kundenservice zusammen, um Synergien zu heben und Retention-Initiativen erfolgreich am Markt zu platzieren.
 Markt- & Wettbewerbsbeobachtung: Du führst regelmäßige Benchmarks durch, behältst Markttrends im Blick und bringst innovative Impulse in das Programm ein.
 Customer-Centricity: Du nutzt Kundenfeedback gezielt als Stellschraube, um die User Experience und den Mehrwert des Apo Cash Programms kontinuierlich zu verfeinern.
 Dein Profil
 Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Marketing, E-Commerce) sowie 3–5 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Loyalty Management, Customer Retention oder CRM – idealerweise im E-Commerce/Retail.
 Kundenverständnis & Kommunikationsstärke: Du denkst konsequent aus Kundensicht und vermittelst komplexe Loyalty-Mechanismen und Kampagnen intern wie extern klar, empathisch und didaktisch geschickt.
 Analytik & Methodik: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, besitzt ein hohes Zahlenverständnis und leitest aus komplexen KPIs treffsichere Retention-Strategien ab.
 Tech- & Tool-Stack: Erfahrung mit modernen CRM- & Loyalty-Plattformen (ideal: Emarsys) sowie gängigen Web-Analytics-Tools. Erste Erfahrung mit KI-Tools (z. B. Gemini, Claude) zur Workflow-Optimierung ist ein Plus.
 Arbeitsweise & Sprachen: Hands-on-Mentalität, starke Schnittstellen-Macher-Qualitäten, fließendes Deutsch (mind. C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (B1/B2).
 Dein Arbeitsumfeld
 Was wir dir bieten:
 Gestaltungsspielraum ab Tag 1: Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit echten Entwicklungsperspektiven, in der du proaktiv Impulse setzen und Strategien aktiv mitgestalten kannst.
 Unbefristete Festanstellung: Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem zukunftssicheren Markt.
 Agiles Arbeitsumfeld: Ein motiviertes, dynamisches Team und flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, die schnelle Umsetzungen ermöglichen.
 Flexibilität mit Teamspirit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten (Home Office & Präsenz) – mit dem Fokus auf unserem Berliner Office, um den gemeinsamen Austausch und den Teamzusammenhalt zu leben. 
 Deine Benefits Auf Einen Blick
 Gesundheit & Mobilität: Urban Sports Club-Membership zum unschlagbaren Preis und ein stark vergünstigtes BVG-Firmenticket für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg.
 Exklusive Vorteile: Attraktiver Rabatt auf unser gesamtes APONEO-Sortiment, Zugang zu vielfältigen Corporate Benefits sowie eine Selgros-Karte.
 Rundum versorgt: Eine betriebseigene Kantine direkt auf dem Campus, täglich kostenfreies frisches Obst, Gemüse und Snacks sowie Kaffee- und Teeflatrate.
 Deine Vergütung & Rahmenbedingungen
 Für diese Position (Vollzeit, unbefristet) bieten wir ein attraktives, marktgerechtes und kompetitives Gehaltspaket. Geplant ist ein jährliches Bruttogehalt zwischen 43.000 € und 54.000 € p.a.
Wo genau du innerhalb dieser Spanne einsteigst, bestimmen wir gemeinsam in einem transparenten Prozess basierend auf folgenden Kriterien:
 Deiner relevanten praktischen Berufserfahrung im Bereich Loyalty, CRM und E-Commerce.
 Deinen fachlichen Qualifikationen und spezifischen Zusatzkenntnissen.
 Der internen Gehaltsstruktur zur Wahrung der Fairness innerhalb des Teams.
 Gleichberechtigung & Fair Pay
 Wir überlassen die faire Bezahlung nicht dem Zufall. Wir vergüten alle Teammitglieder in gleichwertigen Positionen absolut partnerschaftlich, transparent und unabhängig von Geschlecht oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen.
Hast Du Lust, Teil unseres Teams zu werden?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Deinen Lebenslauf, inkl. Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin.

title: Associate Product Manager, TeamViewer Remote and Tensor
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
 Responsibilities
 As an associate product manager, you will take features from idea to launch, with guidance from senior product managers. You will work with engineering, UX, data, support, and go-to-market teams to help users get started with TeamViewer, find the features they need, and use them regularly.
 Run in-app guidance and analytics: Build, launch, and maintain in-app guides, segments, and dashboards, and keep clear documentation of what is live.
 Improve onboarding: Create clear onboarding journeys that help new users set up TeamViewer and reach their first moments of value.
 Build customer habits: Identify the actions that bring users back, and design in-product experiences that encourage regular use.
 Drive feature discovery: Define the ideal path from first use to full adoption, and help users find the features that matter most to them along the way.
 Drive in-product upsell: Design and test in-product prompts and upgrade paths that show users the value of paid features.
 Increase trial conversion: Find where trial users drop off and help more of them move to a paid plan.
 Iterate and optimise: Use testing and data to keep improving onboarding, adoption, and conversion.
 Support discovery and prioritisation: Combine customer research, product analytics, support signals, and competitive insight to identify and prioritise high-value problems.
 Drive delivery and launches: Translate strategy into clear requirements and backlogs, and support go-to-market and feature teams as they release new features.
 Align and influence: Make clear trade-offs across usability, scope, and time to market, and communicate decisions to cross-functional and senior stakeholders.
 Requirements
 Experience in product management, product analytics, growth, or a related role in B2B SaaS or software. Graduates welcome.
 Experience in contributing to a product’s growth through discovery, delivery, launch, and adoption, with measurable outcomes.
 Understanding of SaaS growth models, including freemium, trials, onboarding, activation, feature adoption, habit building, conversion, and retention.
 Working knowledge of product analytics, in-app guidance, funnels, and A/B testing, and the ability to discuss requirements and data with engineering.
 Interest in designing clear user journeys for onboarding and upgrades.
 Customer discovery, analysis, prioritisation, and data-informed decision-making skills.
 Ability to work with engineering, UX, analytics, support, and marketing, translating technical constraints into product choices.
 Clear communication skills, with the ability to write requirements, user stories, and short summaries of results.
 Commercial awareness, an outcome-oriented mindset, and willingness to learn in agile, distributed teams.
 Relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience. Fluent English is required; German or additional languages are a plus.
 What We Offer
 Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
 Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus or sales bonus and regular salary reviews
 Premiums for the private pension plan (BAV) up to the maximum amount are topped up by TeamViewer
 Public transport friendly offices
 Option to lease an e-bike (Germany only)
 Special terms for local gyms
 Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
 Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
 Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
 Hybrid and Flexible work time
 Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country
 We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!
 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

title: Senior Product Manager - Fully Remote Job
description:
About The Company
 Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.
 Our values
 Be a wolf, not a sheep: we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
 Knowledge equals power: we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
 Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy: we want work to be something you look forward to.

 TEAM, Together everyone achieves more: collaboration is how we get our best results.

 What We Are Looking For
 Competences
 Hosting & Security Products Knowledge: Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
 Supplier & Vendor Management: Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
 Commercial & P&L Acumen: Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
 Product Strategy & Roadmapping: Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
 Project & Programme Management: Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
 Data & Funnel Analytics: Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
 AI Proficiency: Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.
 How we work at Openprovider
 Self-management: you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
 Learning Agility and AI Literacy: you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
 Adaptive Innovation Mindset: you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
 Quality Orientation: you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
 Customer Focus: you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.
 What We Offer
 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
 Paid time off and sick leave;
 International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
 Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
 Quarterly review and annual salary review;
 Flexible working hours;
 We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
 Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
 Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
 A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.
 Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.
